25: It is forbidden to erase even one letter of the seven names which may not be erased, and do not [erase] of the letters written after them [as grammatical suffixes] such as the kaf-sofiṫ in elohayich and the kaf-mem-sofiṫ in eloheichem. And these are the seven names: the Name of the Being (YHWH). And the Name of the Lords (Aḋonai). And Eil. Elóah. Elohim. Shadai. Hosts (Tz'va·ot). And there are some who add I am That I Am (Ehye Asher Ehye).
